assumptions.original: The fibers are normalized exponential tilts of one base and the explicit normalized log ratio is integrable under the left fiber.

conclusion.original: Relative entropy equals the left-fiber integral of the explicit normalized log-density ratio.
conclusion.reconstructed: klDiv(mu.tilted f, mu.tilted g) is not top, and its toReal value equals the left-tilt integral of the displayed ratio.
conclusion.evidence: The separate ENNReal finiteness certificate makes the real-valued equality faithful and prevents toReal from masking infinite KL.

scopes.original: Only the value-level KL-to-explicit-ratio step; no assertion of ratio integrability, score identity, LSI, Fisher information, T2, or W2 contraction.
